title: 在 corrected head 上刷新 release evidence 并精确化 triage blocker 语义

criteria: python scripts/refresh_release_evidence.py → retained release evidence 刷新成功
python scripts/release_check_summary.py → release summary 在 current head 重新生成且 blocker 明细与修复后状态一致
python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_governance_scripts.py -q -k 'release_check_summary or local_selftest or triage' → 相关治理回归测试通过

action.detailed_plan: 仅在前置 gate 转绿后刷新 retained evidence，并在 release_check_summary 中把真实 unresolved triage blocker 与 invalid or legacy workflow-state noise 清晰分离。不得 blanket disable unresolved triage，也不得继续依赖 stale superseded evidence。

implementation.action: 审查并修正 scripts/release_check_summary.py 中 unresolved_triage_blocker_signal、local_selftest_enforcement_signal、gate_score_or_critical_blocker_signal 的输入来源与判定逻辑，使真实 unresolved state 仍然阻塞，但无效或遗留噪音不会伪造 blocker。
必要时调整 scripts/refresh_release_evidence.py 的 operator path，确保 local:selftest、writing helper acceptance 和 release summary refresh 按 corrected head 顺序刷新 retained proof。
扩展 tests/unit/scripts/test_governance_scripts.py，覆盖 fresh_current、stale_superseded、legacy_noise 与 real_unresolved 的区分场景。
